decisions.text: arranged: columns by measure: series in different measures: one panel per measure, side by side on the shared categories, each with its own scale (G1.56, G2.32)
categories sorted by How much did each dept. spend? (D-46), largest first, the same order in every panel (G2.1)
one colour for every mark: each panel holds one measure, and the panels tell them apart (G7.6)
How much did each dept. spend?: type bar: categories compared by value

How much did each dept. spend?: bars start at zero
How much did each dept. spend?: scale 0–600 by 200 (at most 3 intervals in a panel about 73 pt wide)
How well did each dept. stick to its budget?: values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
How well did each dept. stick to its budget?: scale −20–20 by 20 (at most 2 intervals in a panel about 73 pt wide)
How much above or below budget was each dept.?: values on both sides of zero: room at both ends

How much did each dept. spend?: labels as a set, 0 decimals, bare numbers: 0, 200, 400, 600

How well did each dept. stick to its budget?: labels as a set, 0 decimals, each with its “%” (owner, 1 Oct 2026): −20%, 0%, +20%

How much above or below budget was each dept.?: a horizontal scale: bare numbers, and its title centred below with the unit in parentheses: “Below/above budget ($K)”
